title: Keep iPhone navigation anchored while scrolling
summary: Keeps the installed iPhone bottom navigation fixed to the bottom of the screen during scrolling instead of letting iOS reposition the transformed dock.
changes: Keeps the bottom navigation anchored to the bottom edge in the installed iPhone app while scrolling.
Removes the scroll transform used to hide the dock on iPhone, preventing the navigation from jumping into the middle of the roster.
Preserves the compact dock size, iPhone safe-area spacing and keyboard hiding behaviour.
Other platforms keep the existing hide-on-scroll behaviour.
